title: Validation Experiment
description: Closed-loop experiment contract for validating positioning hypotheses

hypothesis_id.description: ID of the hypothesis this experiment validates

claim_being_tested.description: The specific load-bearing claim being tested

owner.description: Who is responsible for running this experiment (person, team, or agent)

fidelity.description: low = landing page/smoke test; medium = interview/survey; high = pilot/beta/A-B test

method.description: What exactly will be done to run the experiment

duration.description: How long the experiment runs (e.g., '2 weeks', '30 days')

success_threshold.description: Measurable result that would confirm the hypothesis

failure_threshold.description: Measurable result that would disprove the hypothesis

decision_rule.description: What action to take on success, failure, or inconclusive result

risk_check.description: Ethics and risk assessment: what could go wrong, what safeguards are in place

instrumentation.description: How data will be collected, stored, and analyzed

result.description: Outcome of the experiment (filled when status is completed, failed, or inconclusive)

hypothesis_transition.description: How the hypothesis status should update based on this experiment's result

evidence_produced.description: What evidence type this experiment produces (from the 11-type taxonomy)

cost_estimate.description: Estimated cost in time, money, or effort
